seo.title: About IIV
seo.description: History, mission, vision and organisational structure of Angola's Veterinary Research Institute.

hero.title: An institution serving animal health in Angola.
hero.lead: Learn about the history, mission and structure of the Veterinary Research Institute.

intro.title: Over six decades supporting Angolan livestock farming.
intro.lead: IIV is a public research institution overseen by the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries, with national competencies in animal health diagnostics, production and surveillance.
intro.text: Since its founding in 1965, IIV has played a central role in safeguarding livestock health, supporting veterinary professionals in the public and private sectors, and strengthening national food security.

items.title: Founding
items.text: Establishment of the Institute as the country's central veterinary diagnostic laboratory.

items.title: Regional expansion
items.text: Opening of the first regional stations, extending technical coverage across the territory.

items.title: Vaccine production
items.text: Start of domestic production of veterinary immunobiologicals for the internal market.

items.title: Modernisation
items.text: Technological renewal of laboratories and adoption of international quality practices.

items.title: Digital platform
items.text: Launch of the integrated institutional portal, with online laboratory management and production.

items.title: Mission
items.text: Promote research, diagnostics and production in the field of animal health, contributing to food security and Angola's sustainable development.

items.title: Vision
items.text: To be a reference institution in veterinary research at regional and continental level, with recognised impact on public health.

items.title: Values
items.text: Scientific excellence, integrity, inter-institutional collaboration and commitment to public health and animal welfare.

structure.title: Organisational structure
structure.text: IIV is organised into four main departments — Diagnostics, Production, Research and Administration — each with specialised sub-departments ensuring full coverage of the national veterinary sector's needs.
